description: Na₂Mg(BiO₃)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.72 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent BiO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent MgO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one BiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-47°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.43 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MgO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent BiO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one BiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-62°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.05 Å. There are two inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded to six O atoms to form BiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, corners with two equivalent MgO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.24 Å. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.69 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Bi atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to two Na and two Bi atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and two Bi atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Mg, and two Bi atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and two Bi atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Mg, and two Bi atoms.
